label: rem:braid-lifting-compatibility
title: Compatibility with the lifting theorem
html:
The jet prolongation is compatible with the braided monoidal structure. Suppose \mathbf{C} is braided with braiding c, and each level A_{n+1} = J^1(A_n) of the brane tower is an object of \mathbf{C}, with the section \ell_n\colon A_n \to A_{n+1} and left inverse r_n\colon A_{n+1} \to A_n morphisms of \mathbf{C}. Nothing has to be inherited: every pair of objects already carries the braiding c. What the tower needs is that the transition maps respect it, and this is naturality of c:

  (\ell_n \otimes \ell_n) \circ c_{A_n, A_n} = c_{A_{n+1}, A_{n+1}} \circ (\ell_n \otimes \ell_n),

and likewise for r_n. Applied factor by factor, \ell_n^{\otimes k} and r_n^{\otimes k} intertwine the braid-group representations \rho_k on A_n^{\otimes k} and A_{n+1}^{\otimes k}. The direct-limit algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty = \varinjlim\Gamma(J^1 \mathcal{S}_n, \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)) therefore carries a well-defined B_k-action for every k.
